[p-1a2b3c] SELinux blocked httpd_t (name_connect) on tcp port 8080: a boolean is off
Waiting for your decision, found by basalt on 2026-10-04 10:15 UTC

  SELinux blocked httpd_t because the boolean httpd_can_network_relay that
  allows this is off. SELinux denied httpd_t the name_connect permission on
  tcp port 8080 (labeled http_port_t), 6 times. If you apply it, the assistant
  will turn the SELinux boolean httpd_can_network_relay on.

What will run (exactly these commands, as root, in this order)
  $ setsebool -P httpd_can_network_relay on

Risk: medium (changes what the SELinux policy allows, for every program the
boolean covers).
Undo: a snapshot is taken before and after, so you can go back to the state
before the change; a rollback takes effect at the next boot.
  $ sudo basalt snapshots rollback --before p-1a2b3c

Next step
  Apply it:   sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c
              (without a prompt: sudo basalt apply p-1a2b3c --yes --confirm 8f861434)
  Ignore it:  sudo basalt ignore p-1a2b3c

Evidence
  - raw: avc:  denied  { name_connect } for comm="nginx" scontext=system_u:system_r:httpd_t:s0
